summary: Comprehensive testing completed for Devotio Rewards Scanner App. All features working correctly: Login, card scanning (DEMO and real API), card type handling, PII masking, and card actions. P0 bug fix verified - normalizeCardType() correctly handles Boomerangme API card types.
passed_tests: Backend: Health check endpoint returns healthy status
Backend: Login with demo@devotio.com / demo123 returns valid token
Backend: Invalid credentials correctly rejected with 401
Backend: DEMO-001 scan returns stamp_card with 8/10 stamps
Backend: Real discount card 955355-486-631 returns discount type with 1% level
Backend: PII masking - customer name visible, email/phone masked
Backend: Add-stamp action on DEMO-001 succeeds
Backend: Add-point action on real discount card succeeds
Backend: Redeem-reward action on DEMO-001 succeeds
Backend: All demo card types return correct type (cashback, discount, coupon, multipass)
Frontend: Login page loads and accepts credentials
Frontend: Scanner page loads after login with manual input
Frontend: DEMO-001 stamp card shows stamp grid with 8/10 filled stars
Frontend: DEMO-001 shows 'TARJETA DE SELLOS' badge with Agregar/Canjear tabs
Frontend: Real discount card 955355-486-631 shows 'TARJETA DE DESCUENTO' badge
Frontend: Discount card shows 1% discount level with purchase amount input
Frontend: Discount card has only 'AGREGAR' tab (no Canjear - correct)
Frontend: Customer name visible (Jorge Tou, Maria González, etc.)
Frontend: Email/phone masked (***@***.*** and ***-***-****)
Frontend: Add-point action with purchase amount shows confirmation modal
Frontend: Confirmation modal has mandatory comment field with asterisk
Frontend: Success modal shows 'Transacción Exitosa' after action
Frontend: DEMO-005 coupon shows only 'USAR' tab (single-use)
Frontend: DEMO-006 multipass shows AGREGAR/CANJEAR/PUNTOS tabs (3 tabs)
Frontend: DEMO-002 cashback shows 5% rate with purchase amount input
Frontend: All card type badges display correctly with appropriate icons
seed_data_creation: Using existing DEMO cards (DEMO-001 through DEMO-007) and real Boomerangme API card 955355-486-631
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features verified working. P0 bug fix confirmed - normalizeCardType() in ResultPage.js correctly maps Boomerangme API card types (stamp, cashback, multipass, coupon, discount, gift, membership, reward) to the correct UI configuration. DEMO cards use MOCK data, real card 955355-486-631 uses live Boomerangme API. Spanish language throughout. PII masking working correctly - names visible, email/phone masked.
mocked_api_note: DEMO-* cards use MOCK data for demo purposes. Card 955355-486-631 uses real Boomerangme API with configured API key.
